sections.heading: Welcome
sections.body: Vibe coding is a mindset for crafting delightful software. In this introduction, you'll learn what it is and why it matters.

sections.heading: What You'll Learn
sections.body: We'll cover the foundations, build intuition through examples, and prepare you for interactive exercises.

sections.heading: Setting Expectations
sections.body: This app provides a smooth reading experience with local-first annotations, making it easy to capture insights as you go.
